title: adaptive-slo-thermostat-with-kv-pressure-gating-and-soft-open
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Recent incidents where tenants with large prefix-KV footprints triggered blunt global shed policies exposed two gaps: (1) the SLO enforcer was blind to internal KV memory pressure which caused noisy oscillation when circuits opened/closed, and (2) soft-open transitions were too aggressive for bursty tenants. This change introduces an "SLO Thermostat" controller that combines per-tenant SLO windows with runtime KV-pressure gating and a probe-driven soft-open. The controller reduces oscillation by smoothing SLO adjustments, gates circuit transitions when node KV cache is above pressure thresholds, and provides a probe/holding pattern before promoting a circuit from degraded->healthy.

What this PR contains: single-line summary: implement SLO Thermostat + KV pressure gate + probe-driven soft-open + unit/integration tests + docs and rollout flags. The description below is a single continuous field that contains motivation, design notes, a checklist, commit summary, files touched list, short diffs, CI summary, review comments and the merge outcome.

Design notes: (1) SLO Thermostat: runs in control-plane runtime-manager, computes a short-window SLO error metric per tenant (latency quantile vs target) and applies a smoothed correction factor to tenant weight and circuit threshold. (2) KV pressure gating: runtime exposes node.kv_pressure metric (0.0-1.0). If kv_pressure > gating_threshold (configurable per pool), circuit transitions that would increase load (soft-open/promote) are suppressed and demoted to a probe state. (3) Probe-driven soft-open: when a demoted tenant is eligible for recovery we run N lightweight probe requests (configurable) through an isolated fast path; success moves to half-open then full-open with staged capacity allowance. (4) Safety: config flags feature-flagged under rollout.slo_thermostat.enabled and runtime defaults are conservative. Telemetry added: slo_thermostat.adjustment, slo_thermostat.probes, slo_thermostat.kv_gate_denials.

Rollout plan: feature flagged; start in us-central on dedicated pools with small tenant groups, monitor slo_thermostat.adjustment and kv_gate_denials over 48h, then widen to multi-region. Immediate rollback via rollout.slo_thermostat.enabled=false or autoscaler pool-exclude.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation (control plane + runtime hooks) - [x] Unit tests for thermostat math and gating logic - [x] Integration tests with local kv_pressure simulator - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] Docs snippet in reliability.md - [x] Feature flag gated for controlled rollout - [x] Security review not required (no new external surface)

Commits summary: see commits array for individual commit messages. High level: implement controller, expose kv metric, probe fast-path, tests, docs, e2e harness case for kv pressure bursts.

Files changed (high level): sources/runtime/controller/slo_thermostat.go, sources/runtime/agent/kv_pressure_collector.go, sources/runtime/open_path/probe_handler.go, controlplane/rollout/flags.yaml, telemetry/metrics_registry.yaml, docs/reliability.md, tests/integration/slo_thermostat_kv_sim_test.go, ci/pipeline/slo-smoke.yml

Small illustrative patch snippets (not exhaustive):
- controller/slo_thermostat.go: added gating check before promoting candidate: if nodeMetrics.KVPressure > cfg.GatingThreshold { recordTelemetry("kv_gate_denial"); return Probe }
- probe_handler.go: introduced RunProbes(ctx, tenant, n) -> returns success ratio; success triggers stagedAllowance = min(cfg.StagedPct, previousAllowance*1.5)

CI: initial run failed lint (unused import in tests) -> fixed in follow-up commit -> CI passed on second run. Full CI summary included in ci_status.

Review conversation excerpt: included in review_comments list. Key points: reviewers asked for conservative defaults, asked to add telemetry label, requested explicit unit tests for sub-ms probe timing, and asked to keep gating threshold cluster-configurable. All addressed in follow-ups.

Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge after approvals and green CI. Merge commit included in merge_commit field. Release notes summarized below.

Release notes: Adds an SLO Thermostat controller that smooths per-tenant SLO enforcement, introduces KV-pressure gating to prevent aggressive soft-open during high KV cache pressure, and probe-driven half-open transitions. Feature-flagged and off by default.

review_comments: Ethan Morales (2026-02-18): Why do we need kv_pressure gating instead of adjusting tenant weight? Concerned about global availability impact. Response: gating prevents false positives when node memory is constrained; thermostat still adjusts weights but gating prevents premature soft-open promotions.

Sofia Lindgren (2026-02-19): Please add telemetry labels and make gating threshold cluster-configurable. Also add unit for probe timing edge case. Response: added metrics slo_thermostat.kv_gate_denials and moved gating threshold to pool config with default 0.85. Added unit test for probe timing.

Marcus Zhao (2026-02-20): Add docs outline and conservative default rollout plan. Response: docs/reliability.md updated and rollout plan added; default disabled behind rollout.slo_thermostat.enabled=false.
CI Bot (2026-02-21): Lint failure in tests/integration - unused import fmt. Author pushed fix in g7b8c9d. CI green after fix.
release_notes: Adds SLO Thermostat (per-tenant smoothing) + KV-pressure gating + probe-driven soft-open. Feature-flagged. Conservative defaults; rollout plan described in docs/reliability.md.
notes_on_rollout: Start: enabled on us-central dedicated pools with test tenants. Monitor metrics slo_thermostat.adjustment and slo_thermostat.kv_gate_denials. If kv_gate_denials spike beyond expected baseline, disable feature or raise gating_threshold. Expand to other regions after 48h of stability.
ci_pipeline_run_log: initial: lint failed (unused import) -> fix committed -> rerun -> all checks passed: unit, integration(kv-sim), e2e-smoke, lint, security-scan
performance_impact_summary: Small CPU overhead in control-plane (~2-3% per control-loop tick) and negligible runtime latency for probe-path (probes use lightweight fast-path). Expected net benefit: fewer oscillations and fewer tenant-level SLO violations under KV pressure bursts.
incident_reference: This PR addresses recurring regression observed during INC-4312 where KV-heavy tenants caused oscillatory shedding
repro_instructions: Run tests/integration/slo_thermostat_kv_sim_test.go which simulates node.kv_pressure ramp and tenant QPS spike; verify that slo_thermostat.probe_count metric increments and kv_gate_denials block promotions until pressure subsides.
